title: Pluggable Quality Aggregator and Task-Adaptive Scorers for Quantized Profiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a pluggable, task-adaptive quality aggregation library to calculate composite quality scores for candidate quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) and to power calibration workflows and accuracy validation. The library will normalize and combine multiple metric families (perplexity, MMLU-style classification accuracy, Rouge/BLEU for NLG, and task-specific scorers) into stable, auditable scores used by gating, dashboards, and auto-calibration jobs.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Library exposes a ScorerRegistry that allows registering metric adapters for: perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy suites, Rouge/BLEU (sacreBLEU compatible), and a task-scorer interface for custom scorers.
A2: Aggregator supports configurable per-task weights and multiple normalization modes (min-max, z-score, percentile-based) and documents the default config.
A3: End-to-end evaluation pipeline can run on a quant profile and produce: metric breakdown, aggregate composite score, confidence interval (bootstrap), and delta vs float baseline.
A4: CI gating rule added: block profile promotion when composite-score regression > 1.5% absolute OR any per-task drop > 2% (configurable).
A5: Integration tests validate that the aggregator and scorers run in the existing calibration harness and with the eval CLI.
A6: Dashboard endpoints exist showing per-profile historical scores and per-metric deltas; example dashboard created in Console staging.
A7: Documentation and example configs for common profiles (FP8, INT8 symmetric/asymmetric) are checked into docs/quant/quality-aggregator.md.
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (core library): implement ScorerRegistry, MetricAdapter interface, Normalizer utils, Aggregation strategies (weighted mean, robust trimmed-mean).

Phase 2 (adapters): implement and validate adapters for: perplexity (token-level KL/perplexity and sentence-level ppl), MMLU-style task wrapper (accuracy/top-k), sacreBLEU integration for BLEU, rouge-score wrapper for ROUGE-L, and an inference-time scorer shim for downstream task harnesses.
Phase 3 (harness & CI): wire aggregator into calibration pipeline so each calibration run emits composite score artifact; add gating step in profile promotion job and plugin into PR checks.
Normalization decision: use per-dataset historical baseline to compute z-score by default; provide opt-in percentile normalizer for heavy-tailed metrics (BLEU/ROUGE).
Bootstrap: compute 95% CI by 1000 bootstrap samples on production-sized eval sets (configurable sample count).
Performance: metric computation should be parallelized per-task and support streaming for large NLG datasets to keep memory bounded.
Storage/Artifacts: results stored as CSV + JSON blobs in s3://redwood-evals/quant-profiles/<profile-id>/runs/<run-id>/quality-summary.{csv,json} for downstream pipeline consumption.
Backward compatibility: adapter layer will accept legacy scorer outputs (flat files) and map fields to the canonical MetricRecord schema used by the aggregator.
testing_plan: Unit tests for normalizers and aggregation strategies with synthetic distributions (heavy tail, bimodal).
Adapter smoke tests using mini MMLU subset, synthetic BLEU pairs, and synthetic language model outputs for perplexity calc.
Integration test: run end-to-end calibration job on a toy quant profile and assert composite score computed and gating logic triggers as expected.
Regression test: add golden-binary that runs a known profile and expects stable per-metric values within tolerance to detect flakiness.
Load test: run aggregator over 1000+ NLG examples with streaming BLEU/ROUGE to validate memory and wall-time constraints.
rollout_plan: Canary: enable aggregator in calibration pipeline for internal 'quantation-lab' org only; run on recent FP8/INT8 candidates for 2 weeks and compare deltas.
Validation: cross-check composite scores with manual auditor review on 20 sampled cases per profile to ensure interpretability.
Gradual rollout: enable gating for non-production profiles first; after 1 month, enable gating for staging and then production (Dedicated customers) with opt-out flag.
Fallback: if aggregator is unavailable, pipeline should fall back to legacy per-metric artifacts and mark gating as 'degraded' rather than pass/fail.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Composite score hides per-task regressions. Mitigation: dashboard must always show per-task breakdown and gating rules include per-task thresholds.

Risk: Metric non-comparability across datasets. Mitigation: require dataset metadata and baseline history; disallow aggregation across heterogeneous datasets unless explicit normalization config present.
Risk: Added CI timeouts due to expensive NLG metrics. Mitigation: use sampled sets for CI, full set for nightly/regression runs; cache BLEU/ROUGE results for unchanged references.
